name: The Glitcher 2D
storyline:
You're a student finishing the most important job of your life. After weeks of effort, the deadline is just a few hours away. Everything seems to be ready... until the screen goes black.

A message appears:

SYSTEM CORRUPTED

A strange virus known as The Glitch has infected the computer. Files disappear, programs stop working, and the system starts crashing. If you don't do something, all your work will be lost forever.

In desperation, you use an experimental program that allows you to digitize your consciousness and enter the interior of the computer.

Now you find yourself trapped inside a world made up of the system's own components. To save your files, you'll need to traverse every area of the PC, defeating viruses and fixing bugs that spread across it.
summary: The Glitcher is a top-down 2D survival game inspired by games like Vampire Survivors, NEOHELL, and classic retro arcade titles.
